# OpenAPI schema

`openapi-3.1-schema.json` is the official OpenAPI 3.1 document schema, retrieved from <https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2025-09-15>. It is used offline by `scripts/api.mjs` to validate the document structure. JSON Schema components are additionally compiled with Ajv2020; the runtime registry is derived from the same source and Hey API schema output.
